display.title: {"text": "Great Landmarks"}
description: When Dungeons Arise and Cataclysm's open structures: castles, palaces, sanctuaries you can see on the horizon. Hours to clear, many floors, elite mobs.
&ePrepare:&r Enchanted diamond/netherite or rare+ affixes, healing, a backpack, a waystone or warp scroll home.
&eSignature rewards:&r The Starforged Heart jackpot (vault rooms only), several Ancient Cores, epic/mythic affix rolls in vaults.
&eComing back:&r One clear each; there are dozens per world. Visible from far away thanks to Voxy, so they double as navigation.
&eFeeds into:&r Hearts -> fusion, 256M storage, enhancement sigils, legendary ink.
&aObjective:&r Step inside any structure of this family.
&bWhy it matters:&r Knowing what a family offers before you go makes the trip worth it.
